Name: Pelican4Ever
Author: mtxfujimi
Description:
[size=6][b]🌾 Pelican 4Ever (SV-RTMP)[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]A 24/7 Persistent, Real-Time Online World for Stardew Valley[/b][/size]

Have you ever dreamed of playing Stardew Valley like a living, breathing online world?
[b]Pelican 4Ever[/b] transforms the cooperative multiplayer experience into a [b]persistent, 24/7 real-time world (1:1 scale)[/b] designed for dedicated servers supporting [b]up to 16 players[/b].

Log in whenever you want, tend to your own private farm, meet your neighbors in town, and never worry about stopping the server or forced collapses!

[heading][b]🚀 Preview Server & Playtester Access[/b][/heading]
The [b]Pelican 4Ever Preview Server[/b] is now live for playtesters and collaborators!
Server access is protected via cryptographic device authentication and prior pairing whitelist. To join the playtesting phase:
[list=1]
[*][b]Join the Discord server:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/2x5RuvvQB]https://discord.gg/2x5RuvvQB[/url][/*]
[*][b]Send a direct message (DM) to Dextrure[/b] to request your [b]pairing code[/b] and provide your initial public IP address.[/*]
[*]Once authorized and connected for the first time with the updated mod, your device will be permanently linked, allowing subsequent logins from any IP address.[/*]
[/list]For detailed instructions on setup and requirements, see the Playtester Guide.
[line]

[size=5][b]✨ Key Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]⏰ 1:1 Real-Time Clock & 24/7 Cycle:[/b] 1 real day equals 1 in-game day. The clock moves in lockstep with real time. Thanks to the [i]NightHold[/i] system, late-night farming won't cause you to pass out at 2:00 AM![/*]
[*][b]🏡 16 Private Residences & Farmsteads:[/b] Every player gets their own private land accessible via portals in the Central Plaza. Choose between 8 authentic farm types (Standard, Riverland, Forest, Beach, etc.) with individual caves and anti-griefing visitor permissions (/residencia).[/*]
[*][b]💤 Asynchronous Rest & Energy:[/b] Need to log off? Just sleep in your bed or disconnect anytime. The server keeps running smoothly without kicking other players. Recover stamina by staying well-fed or taking a relaxing dip at the Railroad Spa.[/*]
[*][b]💬 Proximity Chat & Neighborhood Mail:[/b] Talk with fellow farmers using spatial proximity chat (/l), global channel (/g), or private whispers (/w). Send letters directly to your neighbors' mailboxes![/*]
[*][b]🎪 Seamless Live Festivals:[/b] Festivals happen in real time! Walk in and out freely without camera locks, participate in minigames, and celebrate seasonal ceremonies with your community.[/*]
[*][b]🖥️ Built-in Web Dashboard:[/b] Server hosts get a clean, lightweight web panel (accessible in your browser) to check server metrics, monitor online players, and view the world map.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]📦 Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/][b]SMAPI (v4.1.0 or newer)[/b][/url].[/*]
[*]Download [b]Pelican 4Ever[/b] and unzip it into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI. That's it![/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]📋 Required Mods[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]SpaceCore:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Nexus #1348[/url] (Core framework required by NITV)[/*]
[*][b]Content Patcher:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Nexus #1915[/url] (Data injection & compatibility packs)[/*]
[*][b]Nature In The Valley (NITV):[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30138]Nexus #30138[/url] (Wildlife capture, terrariums & creatures)[/*]
[*][b]NITV Multiplayer Support:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30138]Nexus #30138 (Files tab / Optional Addons)[/url] (Multiplayer concurrency patch)[/*]
[*][b]NITV - SH's Wild Animals In The Valley:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42968]Nexus #42968[/url] (Ambient & wild creatures pack)[/*]
[*][b]Fashion Sense (7.5.0+):[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Nexus #9969[/url] (Required for Host cosmetics & body animations)[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]🛡️ Open Source & Security Note (FAQ)[/b][/size]
[quote]
[b]Why does Nexus Mods or my antivirus show an automated safety warning?[/b]
[b]Pelican 4Ever is 100% clean, safe, and completely open-source.[/b]

Because the mod includes an embedded [b]Web Dashboard[/b] (allowing server admins to monitor the game from their browser) and uses [b]Harmony[/b] to adapt game routines to real-time, automated heuristic scanners may trigger a generic false positive.

You can inspect, review, or compile every single line of code directly on our GitHub:
👉 [url=https://github.com/juanlumediterrani/Pelican-4Ever][b]GitHub: juanlumediterrani/Pelican-4Ever[/b][/url][/quote]
[line]

[size=5][b]💬 Feedback & Bug Reports[/b][/size]
Found an issue or have a suggestion? Feel free to open an issue on our GitHub repository or post in the comments tab here on Nexus. Enjoy your persistent farming life in Pelican Town!
